parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
(b)(i)1 A battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $5.6\text{ V}$ and internal resistance $r$ is connected to two external resistors, as shown in Fig. 5.1.

{{figure:figure_5_1.png}}

The reading on the voltmeter is $4.8\text{ V}$.

(i) Calculate:

1. the combined resistance of the two resistors connected in parallel

(b)(i)2 2. the current in the battery.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the internal resistance $r$ is $2.5\,\Omega$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
Determine the ratio
$$\frac{\text{power dissipated by internal resistance }r}{\text{total power produced by battery}}.$$

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
The battery in (b) is now connected to a battery of e.m.f. $7.2\text{ V}$ and internal resistance $3.5\,\Omega$. The new circuit is shown in Fig. 5.2.

{{figure:figure_5_2.png}}
parts.text: Determine the current in the circuit.
